title: 1944: The Loop Master
note: Capcom CPS2 shoot'em up: health, health_p2, credits, bombs (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x4B (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x4B (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

bombs.note: bombs (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL1)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move
